name: App Store Scraper
description: App Store scraper for Python and the command line: Apple App Store apps by keyword or app id (rating, review count, price, version, size, developer), customer reviews of any app, and Apple catalog search for apps, podcasts, music and books, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; no Apple developer account or proxies needed.

commands.name: apps
commands.help: App Store apps by search term or app id
commands.description: Apple App Store apps by search term or by app/bundle id.

inputs.name: term
inputs.description: What to search in the App Store, e.g. "podcast player". Omit it when you pass --app-ids.

inputs.name: app_ids
inputs.description: Numeric app ids (310633997), bundle ids (com.spotify.client) or store URLs.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: App Store storefront, as an ISO country code (default us).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Interface language, e.g. en, it, de.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many apps to deliver at most (1–200). You pay only for delivered apps.

commands.name: reviews
commands.help: customer reviews of one App Store app
commands.description: Customer reviews of an App Store app — rating, title, text, version, votes.

inputs.name: app_id
inputs.description: Numeric App Store id (310633997) or the app's store URL.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Storefront to read the reviews of, as an ISO country code (default us).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many reviews to deliver at most (1–500). You pay only for delivered reviews.

commands.name: search
commands.help: Apple catalog search: apps, podcasts, music, movies, books
commands.description: Apple catalog search — apps, podcasts, music, movies, ebooks — per storefront.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Storefront, as an ISO country code (default us).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many results to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered results.
